=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Adding tests/test_sync_dependabot_exclusions.py to the wg2_modules array takes the pinned module set from 54 to 55 entries, but POLL_GROUP_TWO_8772_MODULE_COUNT = 54 (tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:3427) and POLL_GROUP_TWO_8772_MODULE_SET_SHA256 (tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:3430) were not updated.
  WHY: CI run 43716984159 fails with "AssertionError: 55 != 54" in MovedPollGroupTwo8772StepsContractTest.test_step_body_is_unchanged (line 3495), MovedPollGroupFour8980StepsContractTest.test_step_body_is_unchanged (line 3692) and WiringGuardPartTwoShardingContractTest.test_module_array_is_the_pinned_set_and_the_only_paths_named (line 4105); the sha256 assert fails next, and the aggregate lint job then fails, which blocks merge. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:892, 2484-2492 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The update job's dependabot_sync gate skips only when RELEASE_MANIFEST_VERIFIED == "true" and the helper is unattested, while verify_reproduce runs the helper only when DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED == "true"; so with UPDATER_VERIFY_RELEASE_MANIFEST=false (verified=skipped, line 386) the update job stages a .github/dependabot.yml edit that the verify job never reproduces.
  WHY: verify_pr_tree (scripts/verify_release_manifest.py:690-702 / 653-655) raises VerifyError("unlisted_path") on the unreproduced config, so every updater PR for those consumers fails ai-update-workflows/verify, a regression. Suggested fix: skip whenever DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED != "true" and update the matching test assertion. All reviewers rated this MAJOR; glm reported it under SECURITY.
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:367-504 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: run() sets owned = template_basenames(templates_dir) | set(managed), so _edit_item drops any consumer exclude-paths item whose name matches any workflow-templates/*.yml basename, even when the active profile does not manage it (e.g. .github/workflows/ai-old.yml under "core"); test_sync_owned_entries_follow_a_profile_change (tests/test_sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:172-191) locks this behaviour in.
  WHY: The consumer's exclusion is silently lost and Dependabot again opens bump PRs against that workflow, which contradicts AD-1's promise to keep the consumer's own settings. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR; sonnet and glm rated it NIT because the behaviour is documented in the docstring and changelog. The highest rating is used here.
- changelog.d/9485-dependabot-managed-wrapper-exclusions.md:4-5 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the new upstream .github/dependabot.yml means "action bumps reach consumers through `@stable` releases", but the config scans only .github/workflows/ and not workflow-templates/*.yml; test_upstream_dependabot_config_covers_root_github_actions even asserts "workflow-templates" is absent.
  WHY: Operators will expect template pins (e.g. actions/checkout in workflow-templates/ai-review.yml) to be bumped, and they never will be. All reviewers rated this NIT; glm cited line 5, the others line 4.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:892-902 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On the verified=skipped path the update job runs an unattested upstream script that changes a consumer repo file, with no attestation or hash gate at all.
  WHY: The design comments at 490-496 and 2316-2318 say the helper "is executed only when this release's attested manifest lists it"; the skipped path silently bypasses that gate, so what the two jobs declare and what they actually do diverge (trust-boundary framing of the same gate condition).
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:897 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The update job invokes the helper as `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 "${DEPENDABOT_HELPER}"` without -I -B, while verify_reproduce (line 2487) uses `python3 -I -B`.
  WHY: Without isolation, PYTHONPATH and __pycache__ can affect the update run but not the verify run, although the two jobs are documented to "produce identical bytes". minimax notes the risk is mitigated because the helper imports only stdlib modules (minimax confidence 2, glm 3). Suggested fix: add -I -B.
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:57, 88-162, 487, 504 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No defect: PROFILE_RE, the symlink and size checks in locate_config, and O_NOFOLLOW on write_config guard the inputs.
  WHY: The helper never executes, imports or subprocesses anything taken from its inputs (reviewer rated it NIT, no defect).
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:492-518 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No defect: the helper is re-entrant, and a second run produces outcome=unchanged reason=up_to_date.
  WHY: Both jobs run the same helper and converge to the same bytes by construction (reviewer rated it NIT, no defect).
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:486-518 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No defect: every fail-open path prints a ::warning and exits 0, and main() catches all errors as reason=internal_error.
  WHY: The tests cover CRLF, tabs, anchors, flow style, block scalars, symlinks and the both-config-files case (reviewer rated it NIT, no defect).
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:122-162 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No defect: MAX_CONFIG_BYTES = 256 * 1024 caps reads, and the parser is line-based.
  WHY: The helper runs once per consumer per sync and has no hot path (reviewer rated it NIT, no defect).
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:54-55, 530-534 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No defect: the CLI flags, LOG_PREFIX, CONFIG_CANDIDATES and reason tokens are new identifiers that collide with nothing.
  WHY: No public identifier is removed or renamed (reviewer rated it NIT, no defect).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #9485: "Ship a `.github/dependabot.yml` in the synced template, or merge one into the consumer's own, that ignores the managed wrapper files." (changelog headline: "Dependabot no longer opens bump PRs against the managed wrappers.")
  expected_change_site: scripts/release_manifest.py SURFACE_RULES (lines 74-98): add ("file", "scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py", True) next to the scripts/assemble_agents.py entry at line 88
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/release_manifest.py is not in the diff and SURFACE_RULES has no entry for the helper, so the release manifest never attests it, so with the default UPDATER_VERIFY_RELEASE_MANIFEST=true (update_workflows.yml:367) every consumer logs `DEPENDABOT_EXCLUDE_SYNC outcome=skipped reason=helper_unattested` (update_workflows.yml:892-894) and no consumer Dependabot config is ever edited, the changelog and agents.d fragment call the SURFACE_RULES entry "the follow-up that switches it on", the PR's Deferred scope lists only the actions/checkout pin, scripts/release_manifest.py is outside the plan's files_touched grant (sonnet and glm say the editor must surface this as a scope blocker or record an explicit deferral). Severity: MAJOR from sonnet, gemini, luna and glm; BLOCKER from minimax.
- requirement: Issue #9485 proposed-fix bullet "Bump action versions upstream in coding-workflows. Each `@stable` release then delivers them to the consumers."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/ai-review.yml lines 89, 127, 167 (actions/checkout pins) and sibling workflow-templates/*.yml
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: workflow-templates/ai-review.yml is not in the diff, but the PR's Deferred scope explicitly defers raising the actions/checkout pin and AD-3 reframes it. The reviewer marked this "deferred, not a gap" (NIT); sonnet also skipped it as deferred.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: wg2_modules grows from 54 to 55 entries, but POLL_GROUP_TWO_8772_MODULE_COUNT = 54 (line 3427), POLL_GROUP_TWO_8772_MODULE_SET_SHA256 (line 3430) and the history comment at tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py:3420-3422 were not updated.
  WHY: CI run 43716984159 fails "AssertionError: 55 != 54" in three tests (lines 3495, 3692, 4105), in shards 4, 10 and 14 and orchestrate-poll (0); the lint aggregate then fails. Fix: set the count to 55, recompute the sha256, and add a "#9485 ... (54 -> 55 modules)" comment line.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:around line 892; around lines 2486-2492 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With UPDATER_VERIFY_RELEASE_MANIFEST=false (verified=skipped, line 386) the update job runs the unattested helper and stages .github/dependabot.yml, but verify_reproduce never runs the helper because SURFACE_RULES has no entry for it (line 88).
  WHY: verify_pr_tree (scripts/verify_release_manifest.py:690-702) raises VerifyError("unlisted_path") at line 655, which regresses updater PRs that used to pass. Fix: skip whenever DEPENDABOT_HELPER_ATTESTED != "true" and update the test_dependabot_sync_runs_before_the_wrapper_update_and_gates_the_commit assertion.
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:run() owned = template_basenames(templates_dir) | set(managed); _edit_item() | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Exclude-paths items naming any template basename are deleted even when the profile does not manage that wrapper; test_sync_owned_entries_follow_a_profile_change locks this in.
  WHY: This contradicts AD-1's "keeps the consumer's own settings"; it is a documented design trade-off.
- changelog.d/9485-dependabot-managed-wrapper-exclusions.md:line 4 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog claims action bumps reach consumers via @stable, but the config scans only .github/workflows/.
  WHY: It misleads operators. Fix: reword to say the config covers the source repo's own workflows only.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml step dependabot_sync: use python3 -I -B "${DEPENDABOT_HELPER}" (the test assertion must change too); 2 lines changed; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
